tldr: Mars in Aries: action is fast, direct, and naturally assertive.
body: With Mars in Aries, Mars is at home, so drive moves cleanly through courage, initiative, and confrontation when needed. You do best when energy has a clear target.
gift: Bold action, independence, competitive strength, and the ability to start without waiting.
challenge: Impatience, aggression, and fighting before asking what the fight is for.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
